status: decommissioned — all queues deleted from GCP. Producers now call services/backend/sqs_fanout.py which writes directly to the AWS SQS targets named below. See docs/infra/decommission.md for the per-queue removal log.
method: Static enumeration of every Cloud Tasks producer in artifacts/syrabit-backend/. Wrapper at cloud_tasks_client.py looks up queues by full resource name; queue names below are the project-level convention used by routes/admin_gcp_infra.py and the producers cited.

queues.name: seo-indexnow
queues.purpose: Submit newly published SEO pages to IndexNow + Bing within seconds of publish.

queues.name: seo-internal-linker
queues.purpose: Stage 3 per-page internal-link suggestions written to internal_link_history (action=drafted).

queues.name: discovery-engine-ingest
queues.purpose: Push newly published documents into Vertex AI Discovery Engine for in-app site search.

queues.name: bing-keyword-refresh
queues.purpose: Monthly Bing Keyword Research API refresh, fanned out per-query.

queues.name: bing-submit
queues.purpose: Daily Bing URL Submission API push; one task per URL batch.

queues.name: cf-bot-crosscheck
queues.purpose: Re-validate suspicious bot signatures observed in CF logs.

queues.name: unified-logs-cf-pull
queues.purpose: Backfill / catch-up CF GraphQL log pulls when the in-process loop is paused.

queues.name: email-fallback
queues.purpose: Resend → SES fallback when the primary email path returns 5xx or 429.

verification.owner_action: Re-run at the start of Phase 4 (AWS workers + Azure cron port) to confirm the live queue set still matches this inventory. Any queue present in the API response that is not listed here must be added before producers are switched.
